name: Select obsolete component records
base_args:
exec jq -cne --argjson names "$1" --argjson rows "$2" '
  if ($names | type != "array" or length == 0 or any(.[]; type != "string" or length == 0)) then
    error("expected a nonempty list of discovered component names")
  elif ($rows | type != "array" or any(.[]; type != "object" or (.id | type != "string" or length == 0) or (.name | type != "string" or length == 0) or (.is_current | type != "boolean"))) then
    error("invalid component list")
  elif ($rows | map(.id) | length != (unique | length)) then
    error("duplicate component IDs")
  else
    ($rows | map(select(.is_current) | .name)) as $current
    | ($names | unique | map(. as $name | select([$current[] | select(. == $name)] | length != 1))) as $ambiguous
    | if $ambiguous != [] then
        error("expected exactly one current record for: " + ($ambiguous | join(", ")))
      else
        {delete_ids: [$rows[] | .name as $name
          | select((.is_current | not) or ($names | index($name) == null))
          | .id] | sort_by([(try (split("-") | last | tonumber) catch null), .])}
      end
  end
'
